_comment: DRAFT seed knowledge graph for adult-type diffuse gliomas. Contains NO patient-level information. Grading rules follow WHO CNS5 (Louis et al., Neuro-Oncology 2021). Imaging associations are general neuroradiology knowledge and are marked 'needs_citation' unless a source is given: they MUST be reviewed/cited by a domain expert before publication.

nodes.label: central necrosis / non-enhancing necrotic core
nodes.question: a central necrotic (non-enhancing) core inside the tumour

nodes.label: thick, irregular ring-like contrast enhancement
nodes.question: thick, irregular, ring-like (rim) contrast enhancement on the post-contrast T1-weighted image

nodes.label: extensive solid/nodular contrast enhancement
nodes.question: extensive solid or nodular contrast enhancement on the post-contrast T1-weighted image

nodes.label: non-enhancing tumour (no appreciable contrast enhancement)
nodes.question: no appreciable contrast enhancement on the post-contrast T1-weighted image

nodes.label: extensive peritumoral T2/FLAIR hyperintensity
nodes.question: extensive T2/FLAIR hyperintensity (oedema or infiltration) extending well beyond the tumour core

nodes.label: tumour crossing the midline
nodes.question: tumour extending across the midline (for example through the corpus callosum)

nodes.label: T2-FLAIR mismatch sign
nodes.question: a T2-FLAIR mismatch: a homogeneously T2-hyperintense mass that is relatively hypointense on FLAIR (at most a thin hyperintense rim)

nodes.label: well-circumscribed mass with homogeneous signal
nodes.question: a relatively well-circumscribed mass with homogeneous signal and little heterogeneity

nodes.label: Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype
nodes.description: Most common adult diffuse glioma; WHO CNS grade 4. Diagnosed in an IDH-wildtype diffuse astrocytic glioma with microvascular proliferation, necrosis, TERT promoter mutation, EGFR amplification, or +7/-10.

nodes.label: Astrocytoma, IDH-mutant
nodes.description: Graded 2, 3 or 4 (CNS5). Grade 4 if microvascular proliferation, necrosis or CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion is present; such grade-4 tumours may show necrosis and enhancement similar to glioblastoma.

nodes.label: Astrocytoma, IDH-wildtype (without glioblastoma criteria)
nodes.description: Dataset taxonomy entry (UCSF-PDGM labels): IDH-wildtype diffuse astrocytic tumour lacking glioblastoma criteria, graded 2 or 3 in this cohort. Not a formally defined CNS5 type.

nodes.label: TERT promoter mutation, EGFR amplification, or +7/-10 (molecular glioblastoma criteria)

edges.note: only with microvascular proliferation, necrosis or CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion
necrosis is a histologic hallmark of grade 4; also seen in IDH-mutant grade 4
lower-grade tumours (notably oligodendroglioma) can also enhance
